description: This Java class 'ServiceMcaCondition' defines email message conditions based on headers, fields, or service calls, used for filtering or processing email messages within the OFBiz framework.

classes.name: ServiceMcaCondition
classes.description: A class representing conditions for email message criteria, supporting header, field, and service-based conditions, with evaluation logic.

methods.name: ServiceMcaCondition
methods.description: Constructor that initializes condition based on XML element and condition type.

methods.name: eval
methods.description: Evaluates the condition against a message, dispatcher, and user login, returning true if condition passes.

methods.name: getFieldValue
methods.description: Retrieves specific field values from a MimeMessage based on field name.

methods.name: getBodyText
methods.description: Recursively extracts text content from email body parts.
